2609.30222.title: TrackEverything: Long Horizon Dense Tracking via De-Duplicating 3D Scene Representations
2609.30222.paper_summary: Existing point tracking models face a fundamental tradeoff: they can either track a sparse set of query points over long horizons, or track all points across only short clips. We introduce TrackEverything, a 3D point tracker that breaks this trade-off by representing videos as persistent 3D scene tracks in world coordinates. Grounded in the insight that videos are 2D projections of an underlying 3D world, TrackEverything decouples model complexity from video duration, allowing it to scale with unique physical scene geometry instead. Our approach introduces three key innovations. First, we employ a voxelization-based de-duplication mechanism at sliding-window boundaries to merge co-located tracks, preventing repeated observations of the same surface from redundantly accumulating. Second, we decompose tracking into an endpoint refiner that predicts each point's destination and static-versus-dynamic classification, followed by a lightweight trajectory refiner that decodes dense trajectories exclusively for dynamic points. Third, we propose 3D WAFT, replacing memory-prohibitive 4D correlation volumes with efficient feature sampling in the scene cloud. To the best of our knowledge, TrackEverything is the first 3D tracker capable of tracking all visible points across videos exceeding 1000 frames within 40 GB of GPU memory. On TAPVid-3D, TrackEverything outperforms all open-source all-frame dense 3D trackers by more than 20% APD on short clips, while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art sparse trackers on long sequences, despite tracking far more points.
2609.30222.paper_summary_zh: 現有的點追蹤模型面臨一個基本的權衡：它們要麼能在長時間範圍內追蹤稀疏的查詢點，要麼只能在短片段內追蹤所有點。<lb/>我們介紹了 TrackEverything，一款通過將視頻表示為世界坐標中的持久 3D 場景軌跡來打破這一權衡的 3D 點追蹤器。<lb/>基於視頻是潛在 3D 世界的 2D 投影的見解，TrackEverything 將模型複雜性與視頻持續時間解耦，從而使其能夠根據獨特的物理場景幾何進行擴展。<lb/>我們的方法引入了三個關鍵創新。<lb/>首先，我們在滑動窗口邊界採用基於體素化的去重機制來合併共址的軌跡，防止對同一表面的重複觀察冗餘累積。<lb/>其次，我們將追蹤分解為一個端點細化器，該細化器預測每個點的目的地和靜態與動態分類，然後由一個輕量級的軌跡細化器專門解碼動態點的密集軌跡。<lb/>第三，我們提出了 3D WAFT，通過在場景雲中進行高效的特徵採樣來替代記憶體消耗過大的 4D 相關體積。<lb/>據我們所知，TrackEverything 是第一個能夠在超過 1000 幀的視頻中追蹤所有可見點且僅需 40 GB GPU 記憶體的 3D 追蹤器。<lb/>在 TAPVid-3D 上，TrackEverything 在短片段中超越了所有開源的全幀密集 3D 追蹤器，APD 提高了 20% 以上，同時在長序列中與最先進的稀疏追蹤器保持競爭力，儘管追蹤的點數遠超過其他模型。
